newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Telstra plans A$1.1 bln provision.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Telstra plans A$1.1 bln provision.

text.p: Australia's state-owned telecomunications firm Telstra Corp said on Friday a provision of A$1.1 billion would be raised in the accounts for the 1996/97 year to reflect the amount of planned redundancy payments.
Telstra said its approved strategic plan for the three years ending June 30, 1999 provided for a large reduction in employee numbers by way of redundancies.

"A provision of A$1.1 billion is to be raised in the accounts for the 1996/97 financial year reflecting the amount of redundancy payments to be made as a result of implementing this plan," Telstra said in a statement accompanying its 1995/96 results.
The Australian government plans to sell one-third of Telstra in the 1997/98 financial year to June 30. Telstra has not stated publicly yet how many of its 76,000 staff it would lay off.
Telstra earlier reported a 31.5 percent rise in net profit to A$2.30 billion for the 1995/96 year.
